content: LUZU (luliconazole) Cream, 1% is a topical antifungal medication that contains 1% luliconazole as its active ingredient. Luliconazole belongs to the azole class of antifungal agents. It is presented as a white cream intended for external application to the skin. The chemical name of luliconazole is (2E)-2-[2-(2,4-dichlorophenyl)-2-(1H-imidazol-1-ylmethyl)-1,3-dithiol-2-ylidene]acetonitrile. Its molecular formula is C14H9Cl2N3S2, and it has a molecular weight of 354.28 g/mol. Luliconazole exists as the R-enantiomer, meaning it has a specific three-dimensional configuration, and it contains one chiral center. Additionally, the double bond adjacent to the dithiolane group in its structure is in the E (trans) configuration. Each gram of LUZU Cream, 1% contains 10 mg of luliconazole as the active ingredient. The cream is formulated with a vehicle that includes the following inactive components: benzyl alcohol, butylated hydroxytoluene, cetostearyl alcohol, isopropyl myristate, medium-chain triglycerides, methylparaben, polysorbate 60, propylene glycol, purified water, and sorbitan monostearate.
